image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a golden-brown hamster nestled in wood shavings inside a cage. The hamster has a rounded, compact body with dense fur. Its head is lowered, showing small dark eyes and rounded ears. A green plastic structure and metal cage bars are visible in the background and foreground.
